name_ar: همزة الاستفهام قبل همزة أل التعريف
definition: When an interrogative hamza comes before the hamza of the article, the hamzat al-wasl is replaced by an alef (with a long madd) or softened (with no madd): two readings, and it is never dropped. Three words in four places: آلذكرين (al-An'am 143, 144) and آلله (Yunus 59, an-Naml 59).
limitations: Paraphrase of the cited pages by an automated drafter; not scholarly reviewed.
Only Book A is cited; the printed page is where the section begins and needs proofreading.
A closed list in the Kufian numbering used by the book.
Both readings are listed in `variants`; none is chosen. Nabhan p.36 names the three words, Book A p.31 gives the rule with two examples.
